name: Instagram Reel to AI Content Assistant via Telegram

parameters.content:
Paste an Instagram Reel link into your own Telegram bot and get a full content-strategy breakdown back in seconds - without opening Instagram or watching the video. Built for creators, social media managers, freelancers and small agencies who need to turn saved Reels into something they can post.

## How it works

1. You send a Reel link to the bot.
2. The Apify Actor `lance_api/instagram-video-ai-transcript-scraper-api` transcribes the audio.
3. OpenAI returns a structured analysis: what it is about and why it works, the hook type, target audience, key message, 3 original hooks, 3 content ideas and an original Reel script.
4. The reply is split into numbered chunks when it is long.
5. Results are cached for 24 hours, so re-sending the same Reel costs nothing.

Links that cannot work (profiles, Stories, image-only posts, private or speechless Reels) are rejected before any paid API is called.

## Setup

1. Create a bot with @BotFather and connect the token.
2. Add a Header Auth credential for Apify: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your Apify token>`.
3. Connect OpenAI (default model gpt-4o-mini).
4. Self-hosted: Telegram needs a public HTTPS URL to your n8n (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, reverse proxy).
5. Recommended: restrict `01 — Receive Reel From Telegram` to your own user ID - anyone who finds the bot can spend your Apify credits.
6. Publish, then message your bot.

## Customization

Questions live in `14 — Build AI Prompt`, message wording in `17 — Format Creator Insights`, the model in the `OpenAI Chat Model` sub-node, cache settings in `06 — Check Recent Cache` and `19 — Save To Cache`.

## Requirements

Telegram bot token, Apify account, OpenAI API key. Transcription is billed to your Apify account at about $0.01 per Reel; failures are free.

## TELEGRAM INPUT

Receives the message, pulls the Reel link out of the surrounding text, and answers `/start` and `/help` instantly without calling any paid API.

## VALIDATE & CACHE

Reels and video posts only - profiles, Stories and image-only posts stop here, before any paid call. A Reel analysed in the last 24 hours is answered from cache rather than paid for again.

## INSTAGRAM TRANSCRIPT

Runs the Apify Actor, waits up to 60 s, then re-checks once. A second paid run is never started for the same message, and `maxTotalChargeUsd` caps one run at $1.

## AI ANALYSIS

A Basic LLM Chain with a Structured Output Parser (Auto-Fix Format) turns the transcript into 22 structured fields. Swap the model sub-node for Claude or Gemini and nothing else changes.

## TELEGRAM REPLY & CACHE

Every path - success, cache hit or failure - ends here, so the user always gets an answer. Long replies are split under Telegram's 4096-character limit, then cached for 24 hours.
